info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Building Maintenance Management API
info.description: The Building Maintenance Management API facilitates the retrieval of detailed information about specific maintenance requests and building facilities. It enables users, such as property managers and maintenance staff, to access essential data regarding the status and history of maintenance activities. This API supports efficient management and oversight of building upkeep, ensuring that facilities are maintained to high standards. Typical use cases include checking the progress of ongoing repairs or reviewing past maintenance records for operational insights.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific building maintenance record using its unique identifier. Useful for checking the status and timelines of ongoing maintenance tasks.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving building maintenance details for the specified facility. This request allows clients to fetch operational information, such as maintenance schedules, issues reported, and other relevant data pertaining to the facility identified by the RES-100045 code.

GetBuildingMaintenanceByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the JSON body of the request for retrieving building maintenance operations.

GetBuildingMaintenanceByIdResponse_200.title: Building Maintenance Response

siteId.description: The unique identifier for the site.

assetId.description: The unique identifier for the asset.

workOrderId.description: The unique identifier for the work order.

scheduledDate.description: The scheduled date for the maintenance task.

vendorId.description: The unique identifier for the vendor responsible for maintenance.

facilityZone.description: The specific zone within the facility where the maintenance is to be performed.

estimatedDurationMinutes.description: Estimated duration of the maintenance task in minutes.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the maintenance record.

version.description: The version of the maintenance record.

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the record was last updated.
